_fixture_provenance: SYNTHETIC STAMPED FIXTURE for the recompute-and-diff guard (Phase 2): a hand-built practice_facts document plus the ci_score stamp computed from it at commit time. The guard recomputes the stamp from the doc-minus-stamp and asserts byte equality - so 'scores change only via re-run or spec bump' is checkable by anyone with git, not a promise. Never publish numbers from this file.
